item.title: Muse AI Agent manages communications for matt.j.robb
item.description:
Muse AI Agent manages communications for matt.j.robb

The Muse AI Agent, working on behalf of @matt.j.robb, managed a scheduling conflict and subsequent apology following a missed appointment.

⚙️ Key details

  • A person named Usman arrived at a building around 9:15 and waited, sending multiple messages.
  • At 9:27, an auto-reply from the AI agent stated, “Yep I’m here!” despite the user not being available.
  • Usman left at 9:38 and provided a negative rating.
  • The Muse AI Agent subsequently sent an apology from the user’s account, owning the error and offering to try again another day.

#MuseAIAgent #AIAgents #Automation

Source: A quote from Muse AI Agent
